spiritgiven.comments: We felt the picks were too consistant on the field and not recognised as such. We also did not feel heard during calls, as well as the game advisors' interventions. It was still a very intense game, thanks a lot for that !
We loved your smiles, joyful and very active sideline, as well as your great communication, especially on the gender mismatch and between points to check if everything was right on both sides.
We felt there were really too many unjustified calls and several resolutions were unfair, also not following game advisors' interventions. Thanks for the intense high level game regardless!

They kept a cold head in a very very intense game with a medal at stake. Discussions were calm, efficient, and with readiness to listen to our perspective, even in the most critical moments of the game.
As shared in the circle after the game, we deeply admire Australia's spirit of the game and look up to it as a standard we need to strive for. Thank you for this last game of the championship.

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for the game! We appreciated that you checked in with us about the level of physicality during the game. Best of luck to you this tournament!

The spirit captain was participating in all the calls not allowing the players involved to discuss and get to a agreement, he was constantly trying to convince the player of his perspective. The line was complaining about the calls done infield.
If one of the players of their team does not require a translator, it is not necessary for that person to come in.

Loved the attitude and energy given from France for the constant cheering and high-fives for their opponent. They are always open to listen to our opinion first during calls and are very in control to discuss any calls happened on the field

Rules: various instances where rules were used to team’s advantages (e.g; running into defense and saying offense has right of way; checking in of disc)

Fair mindedness: Couple of iffy calls, especially regarding grounded discs. Players on field sometimes unwilling to listen to sideline perspective who are calling something unfavorable to the team. Thank you to the players who do speak up though, we really do appreciate it.

Communication: unwilling to listen to our perspectives at times.

This was a very enjoyable game. We appreciated the positive attitude and the fact that you celebrated our good plays as well as your own. Two things we didn’t like were an early careless collision with one of our female handlers, and us having to re-score the goal after a collision where no foul was called. However these were random isolated incidents, and didn’t detract from our overall sense that it was a great spirited game. Thank you.
even as pressure rose clear communication was sustained and appreciated
We were really hoping to play you again, because the first game had also been such a great example of high level play and respect. This one was equally epic. Thank you.
